description: Template for a documented voice-consent record. Required whenever a work package involves a real person's voice (cloning, dataset capture, biometric modelling, evidentiary/clinical voice). Copy this file into the work package as consent-record.json and fill every field. The consent-check command validates against the rules in the voice-ai-skill-toolkit (tools-validate.py).
signature_method: wet-ink | e-signature | recorded verbal consent (with transcript reference)

data_handling.storage_description: where raw recordings and derived models are stored

revocation.contact: email or postal address for revocation requests
revocation.process: how a revocation request is submitted and verified
